Hi Kyle short technical clarifications from the infra team: 

1) Encryption: All ingress/egress traffic to our APIs is TLS 1.2+ (we recommend TLS 1.3). At-rest encryption uses AES-256. For Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed keys (KMS) and HSM integration for key wrapping when deployed in customer VPCs or on-prem. Hosted customers can use provider-managed encryption; customer KMS is available on enterprise plans for a dedicated provision.

2) Audit logs & retention: Default request/log retention is 90 days. We can extend retention (configurable) as part of Dedicated contracts or for Private deployments. Logs include per-request metadata (timestamp, route/model, token counts, request id). Full message content retention is configurable and can be set to zero or a short TTL for PHI workloads; note that reducing retention may impact debugging and eval pipelines.

3) KV cache & persistence: The runtime has an optional KV cache to speed repeated prefix calls. For PHI workloads you can disable persistent caching; when disabled, transient in-memory caching remains for the duration of the request only and nothing is written to disk. Dedicated and Private give you explicit control over cache behavior.

4) PHI content & token length: We do not restrict specific PHI content types; full identifiers and clinical notes are permitted under a signed BAA and appropriate deployment (Dedicated or Private recommended). Token length limits are driven by the model; we surface sequence-length controls in the deployment config we can provision models with larger context windows depending on the SLA.

5) Performance tradeoffs: Dedicated offers predictable throughput with GPU pools and tighter SLOs. Private on-prem gives the most control over networking and data residency but may require more ops coordination. Hosted provides fastest onboarding but has more constraints for PHI unless a dedicated contract is in place.

- Marissa/legal will share a redlineable BAA; Legal can either sign our standard template (attached) or propose edits.
